correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation of the source's own Type-II log-likelihood gives \(\ell''=-r/\alpha^2-(n-r)z^\alpha(\log z)^2/(1-z^\alpha)^2\). Algebraically rewriting this over the source denominator shows that the printed expression is \(\alpha^2\ell''\) only after setting \(r=3\). Numerical differentiation of the actual likelihood agrees with the corrected formula. The strict negative sign follows immediately for every admissible sample.

value.rationale: The erroneous Hessian is the paper's stated basis for asymptotic variance and confidence intervals and is also referenced in the MCMC proposal construction. It fails for the general censoring count and, even on the accidental \(r=3\) slice, rescales inverse information by \(1/\alpha^2\). The corrected formula additionally proves global strict concavity of the Type-II likelihood in the model parameter, a useful inferential structural fact.
